chars.ISMAIL: ISMAIL: a thin young man wearing a faded red hoodie with white drawstrings, torn dark blue jeans, dusty white sneakers and a worn black backpack.
chars.HAJ: HAJ: an old homeless man with a very long messy white beard, wearing a long dirty stained brown overcoat over a grey djellaba, a frayed green wool scarf and old torn sandals.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a dark Casablanca back street under one orange street lamp. ISMAIL is bent over a green municipal trash bin digging for food, and he turns around startled and scared because HAJ is standing right behind him, staring at him intensely. Tense, suspicious moment between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a dirty Casablanca alley with closed shop shutters. ISMAIL alone, exhausted and starving, kneeling and searching inside a trash bin, holding his stomach from hunger, sad face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night street in Casablanca. HAJ walks slowly straight toward ISMAIL who is standing next to a trash bin; ISMAIL steps back nervously, worried expression.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot of HAJ standing under a street lamp at night: his long messy white beard, dirty stained overcoat and torn sandals are clearly visible; calm mysterious look.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night next to a trash bin in a Casablanca street. HAJ leans toward ISMAIL and speaks to him with a raised hand, asking a question; ISMAIL holds an empty plastic bag, surprised.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night street. ISMAIL looks down at the ground, ashamed and embarrassed, hand on his stomach; HAJ looks at him kindly with concern.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small cheap Moroccan snack shop at night with a counter and plastic chairs. ISMAIL and HAJ sit at a small table; ISMAIL eats a big sandwich hungrily while HAJ sits silent, holding his sandwich, staring into the distance mysteriously.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same small Moroccan snack at night. ISMAIL leans forward across the table, curious, asking HAJ a question; HAJ looks down with deep sadness, a tear in his eye.
